changeSet.author: trade-loan-team
changeSet.comment: Add payment audit trail columns to loan_installments for Installment Collection service

column.name: last_payment_reference
column.remarks: Payment reference ID from legacy core for the most recent payment

column.name: last_payment_channel
column.remarks: Channel through which the most recent payment was received (e.g. BRANCH, ATM, INTERNET_BANKING)

column.name: last_legacy_transaction_reference
column.remarks: Legacy core GL/transaction reference for reconciliation

column.name: last_value_date
column.remarks: Banking value/settlement date of the most recent payment
